area_note: South Bali (Sanur, Renon in Denpasar, Canggu, Seseh and Uluwatu) and Ubud
intro: Bali's group runs are spread across the island rather than centred on one park. In Denpasar and Sanur, the local IndoRunners chapter meets at the Bajra Sandhi monument in Renon and at Mertasari in Sanur. On the west coast, most Canggu and Seseh run clubs start from cafés and gyms, and Ubud has its own club that runs from coffee roasteries. Runs start early, mostly between 6am and 7am, to beat the heat. Clubs post their schedules and start points on Instagram, and several of them take no sign-ups: runners just turn up.

clubs.name: IndoRunners Bali
clubs.description: The Bali chapter of the national Indo Runners community, running in Bali since 2012. Its Linktree links to the two meeting points and to a short guide on how to join.

clubs.name: Rise Run Bali
clubs.description: A large community run club whose Instagram account has about 45,000 followers. Bali Buddies listed Canggu start points including The Goat Father, The Body Factory, The Dog House and Just Oats, and Uluwatu start points including Local Expats, Kanu and Ulu Active. Check the club's Instagram highlights for the current week before going; some days on its website are marked on hold.

clubs.name: Flowerboy Run Club

meets.when: Wednesdays and Saturdays 6am (5 km or 10 km)

clubs.description: A run club based at a coffee and flower shop in Seseh, near Canggu, with a choice of 5 km or 10 km routes.

clubs.name: FAR Ubud Run Club
clubs.description: Ubud's run club, which runs from Wednesday to Sunday and posts the week's schedule in a pinned Instagram post. Routes range from short rice-field loops to longer runs, and the club is linked to the Ubud Running Festival.

clubs.name: Continuum Athletics
clubs.description: A Canggu-based performance training group that holds weekly speed and threshold sessions. Start points are posted on Instagram.

coaches.name: Rise Run Bali coaching (Rise Plan)
coaches.offers: Rise Plan online coaching at AUD 35 per week: pre-screening form and video review, an 8-week tailored run and/or strength plan delivered in a training app, and weekly online check-ins. The site also advertises a week-long running retreat in Canggu (dates and prices not published)
coaches.where: Online; the club itself meets in Canggu
coaches.credentials: Founder Sinead MacCana is a UESCA-certified running coach (UESCA directory)
coaches.description: The paid coaching arm of the free Rise Run Bali community club. The plan is delivered remotely by its founder, who is no longer based in Bali.
coaches.active_evidence: Plans page checked 6 Nov 2026; club Instagram posts, 31 Oct to 6 Nov 2026

coaches.name: Anastasia Perwanti
coaches.offers: In-person and online coaching, mainly for beginners and recreational runners, combining structured running with strength, recovery and mindset work (per her UESCA directory profile; no prices published)
coaches.description: A Bali-based coach who also works as an event and race planner. Her coaching focuses on building sustainable running habits and avoiding injury.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 31 Jul to 1 Nov 2026; UESCA directory profile checked 6 Nov 2026
